source_verifiee: data-lake/TER/10K/TER_2026-02-19.htm.gz (10-K FY2025) ; data-lake/TER/10Q/TER_2026-07-31.htm.gz (10-Q T2 2026, periode close le 28 juin 2026)

controles.affirmation: Les cinq plus gros clients directs ont represente 44% du CA consolide en 2025, 36% en 2024, 32% en 2023.
controles.verbatim_source: In each of the years, 2025, 2024 and 2023, our five largest direct customers in aggregate accounted for 44%, 36%, and 32% of our consolidated revenues, respectively.

controles.affirmation: En 2025, un client du segment Semiconductor Test a pese 19% du CA consolide (achats directs inclus) ; deux autres clients ont specifie 12% et 10% du CA sans etre necessairement acheteurs directs.
controles.verbatim_source: In 2025, we had two customers who specified greater than 10% of our consolidated revenues and one additional customer who directly purchased more than 10% of our consolidated revenues. The two specifying customers were both customers of our Semiconductor Test and Product Test segments and drove 12% and 10% of consolidated revenues. The additional direct customer, a customer of our Semiconductor Test segment, accounted for 19% of consolidated revenues including certain revenues specified by other customers.

controles.affirmation: Semiconductor Test = 79% du CA 2025 contre 75% en 2024 ; Product Test 11% ; Robotics 10% (13% en 2024).
controles.verbatim_source: Revenues (segment 2025) : Semiconductor Test $2,523,744 | Robotics $308,295 | Product Test $357,985 | Consolidated $3,190,024. Pour 2024, le 10-K indique « The increase in Semiconductor Test revenues of $399.8 million, or 18.8% ... The decrease in Robotics revenues of $56.5 million, or 15.5% ... The increase in Product Test revenues of $26.9 million, or 8.1% ».

controles.affirmation: Au T2 2026, Semiconductor Test a progresse de 128,1% (+629,9 M$).
controles.verbatim_source: The increase in Semiconductor Test revenues of $629.9 million, or 128.1%, was driven primarily by higher sales in compute and memory related to artificial intelligence applications.

controles.affirmation: 29,4 M$ de charges de licenciement en 2025 dont 24,3 M$ lies a la restructuration de Robotics, touchant environ 400 employes.
controles.verbatim_source: During the year ended December 31, 2025, Teradyne recorded $29.4 million of severance charges, $24.3 million of which is related to the Robotics restructuring which impacted approximately 400 employees

controles.affirmation: L'ecart d'acquisition de Robotics s'eleve a 416,4 M$ fin 2025, soit 80% du total du groupe (521,0 M$) ; test de depreciation declenche le 29 juin 2025 sans depreciation.
controles.verbatim_source: the Company's goodwill balance was $521.0 million as of December 31, 2025, and the goodwill associated with the Robotics reporting unit was $416.4 million ; At June 29, 2025, the Company identified a triggering event for the Robotics reporting unit and performed an interim impairment test of the related goodwill and long-lived assets, including intangible assets. Based on the analysis performed, Teradyne did not record an impairment.

controles.affirmation: Taiwan a represente 36,2% du CA 2025 contre 21% en 2024 ; 40% au T2 2026 et 41% sur le semestre, devant la Coree (20%) et la Chine (11%) ; Chine a 14,1% du CA 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : « Taiwan 36% | 21% » (revenus par pays en % du total) ; « Taiwan $1,155,195 ... China 451,294 ... $3,190,024 » ; 10-Q T2 2026 : « For the Three Months Ended June 28, 2026 : Taiwan 40% ... » et « For the Six Months Ended June 28, 2026 : Taiwan 41% | Korea 20 | China 11 » contre « Taiwan 31 | Korea 10 | China 17 » un an plus tot.

controles.affirmation: Controles a l'export vers la Chine (regles du Department of Commerce, liste des utilisateurs finaux militaires), impact non chiffrable par la societe.
controles.verbatim_source: we must comply with current U.S. Department of Commerce export control regulations restricting transactions with certain customers in China ; we cannot quantify the impact that the export controls and economic sanctions has had on our sales ; The U.S. Department of Commerce issued and continues to update a list of companies in China and other countries that it considered to be military end users.
controles.correction_proposee: Conforme. Nuance de forme : les deux fragments cites entre guillemets et relies par « ... » proviennent de deux facteurs de risque distincts du 10-K (Item 1A) et non d'une phrase continue. Preferer deux citations separees.

controles.affirmation: Resultat avant impots +26% pour Semiconductor Test en 2025, contre -28% pour Robotics.
controles.verbatim_source: Income (loss) before taxes (2025) : Semiconductor Test 700,734 | Robotics (99,367) | Product Test 60,692 ; (2024) : Semiconductor Test 558,168 | Robotics (77,552) | Product Test 65,724
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres exacts (+25,5% et perte creusee de 28,1%). Ambiguite de formulation a corriger : « -28% » peut se lire comme une baisse depuis un resultat positif, alors que Robotics est deja en PERTE, passee de -77,6 M$ a -99,4 M$. Reformuler : « la perte avant impots de Robotics se creuse de 28%, de -77,6 M$ a -99,4 M$ » — plus factuel et plus fort.
